prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a sunny seaside promenade of pale paving stones with a waist-high white railing, a lamp post and a row of normal-height beach huts, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, THREE people standing close side by side, shoulder to shoulder in a single row, with just enough spacing that every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back far enough that all three are visible from head to toe, the whole row filling the width of the tall frame, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Japanese woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a deep bronze tan foundation over real skin, thick white paint bands above and below both eyes lying on the lids and never across the eyeballs, silver glitter lines across the lids, heavy black liner, very long false lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy white lips, small rhinestone stickers on the cheeks only, a fierce, playful expression, pure icy-white hair styled in a crown braid wrapping around the head, real living eyes, wearing matching-style earrings on both ears, each ear a large rose-gold hoop carrying three heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on rose-gold chains of different lengths (a lead cube-shaped block, a gold miniature anvil, a silver pyramid-shaped lump), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and an extreme maximalist stack of well over ten gold bracelets. Extremely long square nails, chrome finish studded with crystals.
LEFT Physique: an extraordinarily curvaceous woman, far beyond any real person; a sharply cinched waist rises out of hips that sweep outward in a single smooth violin-shaped curve, the hips and thick rounded thighs flaring many times wider than the waist and dominating her silhouette from the front and side, a firm high rounded rear, a full round bust balancing the curve above; the line from waist to hip to thigh is one long unbroken curve; not thin, not boyish, not a straight figure; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
LEFT Body Art: Her body carries a dense printed-circuit surface grown over her skin, raised copper traces and solder pads running in tidy right-angled lines over every curve, tiny rectangles of black silicon chips set into the surface, BLAZING matte black circuit-board surface with gold copper traces, VIVID electric cyan light pulses racing along the traces and small glowing LED points. It is fused to her own living skin and flexes slightly over every bulge, with no fabric, seam or garment anywhere. It covers her whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left bare and the material fades out at the neck with no hard line.
LEFT Pose: mid-stride walking toward camera.
